kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ارجحننت (form IVq)
# اِرْجَحْنَنْتُ (irjaḥnantu) /ir.d͡ʒaħ.nan.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
# اِرْجَحْنَنْتَ (irjaḥnanta) /ir.d͡ʒaħ.nan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
# اِرْجَحْنَنْتِ (irjaḥnanti) /ir.d͡ʒaħ.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
